newsitem.title: FRANCE: France raises oilseed harvest estimates.
newsitem.headline: France raises oilseed harvest estimates.

text.p: France slightly raised its estimate for the 1996 rapeseed crop to 2.89 million tonnes, a 3.6 percent increase over 1995, the farm ministry said on Friday.
Its previous estimate, published in September, was for 2.885 million tonnes. Last year's crop was 2.789 million.

The ministry's statistical office, SCEES, said it had also raised its estimate for the total 1996 oilseed harvest to 5.104 million tonnes from a September projection of 5.087 million, further surpassing last year's crop of 5.037 million tonnes.
Sunflower production was revised up to 1.973 million tonnes from 1.952 million. Last year's crop was 1.987 million.
The ministry however lowered its estimate for the relatively small soya crop, shaving it to 242,000 tonnes from a previous 250,000 tonnes. Last year France produced 261,000 tonnes.
